body.heading: Where in the world is Saint Kitts and Nevis?
paragraphs: Saint Kitts and Nevis is a country in the Caribbean, which is part of North America. It is an island country, surrounded by sea.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Saint Kitts and Nevis is Basseterre.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Saint Kitts and Nevis is English.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Saint Kitts and Nevis is the East Caribbean dollar.

body.heading: How big is Saint Kitts and Nevis?
paragraphs: Saint Kitts and Nevis covers about 261 square kilometres of land and inland water. It is the smallest country in North America.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Brimstone Hill is a massive hilltop fortress called the 'Gibraltar of the West Indies', with cannon views over the Caribbean and across to other islands.
A narrow-gauge railway loops the island past sugar cane fields and gorges — the last railway in the West Indies, with calypso singers aboard.
